Job Title: Senior Mobile Engineer
Experience: 8+ years
Location: Hybrid: Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Swift
- Objective-C
Good to have:
- Xcode
- SwiftUI
- Combine

Responsibilities:
- Lead design and delivery of native iOS features for a consumer-facing mobile app used by millions, working across product, design and backend teams.
- Architect, implement and maintain high-performance, well-tested codebases in Swift and Objective-C; own modules from design through release and production support.
- Mentor and review code for mid and junior engineers; drive best practices around app architecture, testing, CI/CD and release management.
- Collaborate with backend engineers to define APIs, optimize network usage and implement resilient offline-first behaviors.
- Drive performance profiling and memory management improvements; troubleshoot and resolve complex runtime issues and crashes.
- Contribute to UI/UX implementation and accessibility, working with designers to translate mocks into pixel-perfect, maintainable code.
- Evaluate and introduce modern iOS frameworks and tools; gradually migrate legacy Objective-C components where appropriate.
- Participate in sprint planning, technical roadmapping and cross-functional feature scoping; represent mobile engineering in stakeholder discussions.
